connected_learning.reason: A teacher-owned MIP whose core is students' own project work (tasks 3, 4, 6); interests, peers, production, shared purpose and opportunities are already present, but nothing links the project to home or community, no adult besides the teacher is involved, and no audience beyond the teacher is stated. Each gap can be closed by an allowed edit within existing tasks.

pb_process.reason: No constituency and no shared public resource: each team divides its own time (shared_resource.kind = time_own_team).

pb_prioritise.reason: Task 3 generates several build options, but choosing among them is a team's decision about its own work, not a legitimately collective decision.

pb_allocate.reason: Neither pb_process nor pb_prioritise is APPLY, so no group votes and there is no budget ballot.

budget_capped_choice.reason: Each team has a hard cap of about 20 team-hours (owner context) and usually wants to build more than fits, while pb_process is ABSTAIN; knapsack reasoning fits task 3, labelled 'adapted from knapsack voting'.

credit: PB-ideas: task 3 already has teams list what they plan to build
constraints: label it 'adapted from knapsack voting'; never 'participatory budgeting' or 'the Stanford PB phase' (PB-not-pb)

evidence_based.reason: Not foundational literacy or numeracy, below_grade_level is not 'yes', and it is project work rather than regular subject teaching (subject_teaching = false); it is not planning-only, so no EB branch applies.
